SELECTED DETECTION METHOD

Flagged observations

Flags identify unusual values, not proven equipment failures. The report includes every flagged observation for every mine and the total.

Methods and data notes

Statistics use all loaded dates. Standard deviation uses n − 1; quartiles use linear interpolation. Total is recalculated from the mine columns and checked against the spreadsheet.

IQR flags values outside Q1 − k × IQR and Q3 + k × IQR. Z-score flags absolute standardized distances above the selected threshold. Moving-average flags use percentage distance from a full trailing window, excluding the current day. Grubbs is a classic two-sided test for one most extreme value.

Production may contain weekly patterns, trends and correlation. These can violate the assumptions of Grubbs' test. Flags are exploratory and no observations are removed.

The generator has capacity for 10 mines and 366 days. Refresh reads the Output tab. Analysis and PDF export use the same saved snapshot, so changing spreadsheet inputs does not change an already loaded report.
